cases.question: Based on the conversation between Caroline and Melanie, on what date did Caroline go to the LGBTQ support group?

nodes.text: Session between Caroline and Melanie started at 1:56 pm on 8 May 2023.

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: Hey Mel! Good to see you! How have you been?

nodes.speaker: Melanie
nodes.text: Hey Caroline! Good to see you! I'm swamped with the kids & work. What's up with you? Anything new?

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: I went to a LGBTQ support group yesterday and it was so powerful.

nodes.speaker: Melanie
nodes.text: Wow, that's cool, Caroline! What happened that was so awesome? Did you hear any inspiring stories?

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: The transgender stories were so inspiring! I was so happy and thankful for all the support.

claims: Caroline went to the LGBTQ support group on 7 May 2023

cases.question: What did Melanie realize after her charity race?

nodes.speaker: Melanie
nodes.text: Hey Caroline, since we last chatted, I've had a lot of things happening to me.

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: That charity race sounds great, Mel! Making a difference & raising awareness for mental health is super rewarding

nodes.speaker: Melanie
nodes.text: Thanks, Caroline! The event was really thought-provoking. I'm starting to realize that self-care is really important.

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: I totally agree, Melanie. Taking care of ourselves is so important - even if it's not always easy.

nodes.speaker: Melanie
nodes.text: Yeah, it's tough. So I'm carving out some me-time each day - running, reading, or playing my violin

claims: Melanie realized that self-care is important after her charity race
